definitions.explanation: In baseball, a hit that lets the batter reach second base or beyond — a double, triple, or home run. Valued for advancing or driving in runners more than a single does.

examples.japanese: {長打|ちょうだ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二塁|にるい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: He advanced to second base on an extra-base hit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長打|ちょうだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This batter gets a lot of extra-base hits.

examples.japanese: {九回|きゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長打|ちょうだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An extra-base hit came in the ninth inning, and they suddenly turned the game around.

notes:
Compound of {長|ちょう} (long) + {打|だ} (hit). A baseball term contrasting with a ⟦{単打|たんだ}→単打：29482_tanda⟧ (single).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長打|ちょうだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧: to hit an extra-base hit
- {長打|ちょうだ}{力|りょく}: power for extra-base hits (slugging ability)
- {長打率|ちょうだりつ}: slugging percentage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単打|たんだ}→単打：29482_tanda⟧: single — a hit reaching only first base
- ⟦{本塁打|ほんるいだ}→本塁打：24569_honruida⟧: home run — the longest extra-base hit, circling all the bases
